The mass of a piece of metal is 1200g.
A measuring cylinder contains 150cm3 of water.
The piece of metal is put into the measuring cylinder. The water level rises to 250cm3 and covers
the metal.
What is the density of the metal?

4.8g/cm3
8.0g/cm3
12.0g/cm3
